scripts.dev:container: corepack yarn workspace container run dev --port 3000 --strictPort
scripts.dev:workflow: corepack yarn workspace workflow run dev --port 3001 --strictPort
scripts.build: corepack yarn workspaces foreach --all -pvi -j 4 run build
scripts.prepare: corepack yarn workspaces foreach --all -pvi -j 4 run prepare
scripts.dev:workflow:watch: corepack yarn workspace workflow run build:watch
scripts.dev:mfe: concurrently --names "container,workflow-build,workflow-serve" --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:container" "npm run dev:workflow:watch" "npm run serve:workflow:remote"
